ov: A small fox of the Arctic tundra with thick fur and a big, fluffy tail. The common form is brown in summer and turns white in winter to blend in with the snow.
rg: Arctic regions right around the Northern Hemisphere.
df: Lemmings, voles, ringed seal pups, fish and seabirds, plus carrion, berries, seaweed and insects.

cf.tip: The Arctic fox is smaller than the red fox, with a rounder body and white winter coat.

fx: In winter it slows its metabolism by about a third to save its fat reserves.
